name: leader-portfolio
description: Full-stack MERN portfolio website for an Indian political leader

scripts.install-all: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix server --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "CLIENT,SERVER" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix client
